attributes.title: Triage
attributes.lede: Nine tests are red in a run of sixty. Find each one without losing your place.

lesson.concept: Motion can help a person locate an unknown result
lesson.why: Scroll reveals where the next failure sits in a long run, Raise gives that result temporary emphasis, and Hold keeps attention there long enough to read it.
lesson.experiment: Advance to successive failures and notice distance and clustering. Compare Scenic jump with Jump cut without losing the highlighted target.
lesson.pitfall: Scrolling to a destination already obvious beside the button adds movement without teaching location.
lesson.combine: Combine with gates when each discovered result becomes the next step in a guided explanation.
